description: This is a C# test class for NATS streaming integration testing, using Orleans, Xunit, and custom NATS connection/setup code.

classes.name: NatsStreamTests
classes.description: A test class for NATS streaming integration tests using Orleans and Xunit, with setup and teardown of streams.

classes.name: MySiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo to add NATS streams and memory storage for testing.

classes.name: MyClientBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans client to connect to NATS streams.
